official_statement_rationale: While headline CPI inflation at 4.85 per cent remains within the tolerance band, the persistence of food inflation at 8.52 per cent and the prevailing uncertainties regarding global crude oil prices at $90.45 per barrel necessitate continued vigilance. The positive output gap of 0.40 per cent suggests that demand-side pressures remain, and it is imperative that we do not prematurely signal a shift in our policy stance. Maintaining the repo rate at 6.50 per cent and continuing with the stance of withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure that inflation durably aligns with the 4.00 per cent target while supporting the ongoing growth momentum of 6.30 per cent GVA. We must remain committed to the disinflationary process to ensure that inflation expectations remain firmly anchored.
